title: SOMEONE PLEASE CREATE THIS GAME
author: OutrageousShare9693
selftext:
Name: The Slop Will Prevail (still open to other ideas).

So, the game is a pixel art platformer. All the assets in the game are AI generated except for the enemies, which are the luddities. All the luddities are 100% hand drawn (that's why they look shitty). You play as "Optimus Prompt", your objective is to go around the city and exterminate the hand-drawn antis. You get their art as loot and you feed their art to the AI mother which is forever hungry for luddities art, she will give you upgrades for doing that.

This game is going to become an instant classic. Someone NEEDS to create it and I want to be a part of it.

(BTW, if someone wants to create this game please hire me to work for you, I'm a pixel artist and I use AI assistance workflow, but I can also hand draw the shitty luddities.)
